response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.death_state AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON h.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(s.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_above_average FROM s, a WHERE s.cnt > a.avg_cnt
